BiblicalUsage: Ephlal — intercessor — is a descendant of Pharez named once in the genealogy of Judah, the son of Zabad. One verse is all he gets, and it is enough: his name is kept in the line that leads to David.
TheologicalSignificance: A single verse in a genealogy is still a place in God's story. I believe Ephlal is remembered because the line was remembered, and the line was remembered because it led to David.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
